answer: An identity's answers must stay mutually consistent across epochs: a claim contradicted by its own later submission voids both, and the pair is flagged at replay. The comet history is re-read at each close, opal lists the contradictions, and trellis records the voided pairs. A farm that generates text cheaply cannot hold a coherent position over 14 epochs, which means its own output eventually convicts it. A farm of 209 pays that 74 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
